# The steps `tools/ci.ps1` is ALLOWED to skip on the CI runner. Everything else
# must run. `.github/workflows/ci.yml` passes this file as -ExpectedSkips, and
# the gate fails on any difference in either direction -- a step that skipped
# and is not named here, and a step named here that did not skip.
#
# THIS FILE IS NOT A DESCRIPTION OF A DEVELOPER MACHINE. A workstation without
# SciPy, without WiX, without the wasm target skips more than this and that is
# fine; run the gate with no -ExpectedSkips there. This is the list for a runner
# that has been given everything a runner can be given, and its whole job is to
# make the difference between "the gate passed" and "the gate ran" impossible to
# miss. The gate passed on the author's machine with six steps skipped for six
# releases and no line anywhere said so.
#
# Every name below is here for ONE reason, and it is the same reason: the step
# needs -Corpus, and the corpus is real laboratory .dna and .ab1 files. Those
# are not ours to publish -- Addgene's terms are noncommercial with an
# anti-scraping clause, and a lab's plasmid files belong to that lab -- and
# `.gitignore` bans `*.dna`, `*.ab1`, `*.scf` and `*.ztr` so that a stray
# `git add -A` cannot make them ours either. So this is not a gap to be closed
# by installing something. It is the one honest skip, five times.
#
# THERE IS NO ENTRY FOR A NETWORK SERVICE, and that is deliberate rather than
# lucky. No step in the gate fetches from a third-party data source: `ci.ps1`
# itself names no URL and makes no web call -- its only two `Invoke-WebRequest`
# strings are inside the banned-token lists of the steps that forbid one -- and
# the two feature-database steps it runs are the offline pair, `check_signoff`
# and `check_writer`, over the committed tables. The live-source build moved to
# `.github/workflows/features-live.yml` on 2026-08-07, after EBI timed out twice
# and turned main red for a reason no commit under test had anything to do with,
# and that file's header states the rule: if a step's result would still be true
# tomorrow with the network unplugged, it belongs in ci.yml instead.
#
# So there is no step here to make non-fatal and none to declare skipped for an
# outage. What the `gate` job does need the network for is provisioning --
# cargo's registry, pip, npm, the WiX tool -- and that happens in its own steps,
# before the gate, where a failure is an obvious red install step rather than a
# silent SKIP.
#
# Names are matched exactly, and a name matching no step in the gate is itself a
# failure. So renaming a step below without editing this line goes red, rather
# than quietly reporting that the step has started running.

wasm module vs native binary
rendered chromatograms agree with their files
chromatograms vs Biopython
digest vs Biopython (real plasmids)
rust reader vs python reader
